customManagers.description: Track the Antora UI bundle pinned in the playbook. No built-in manager reads a URL inside a YAML value, so without this the pin never moves (vshn/antora-ui#204).

packageRules.description: Patch releases of the UI bundle merge once the docs build passes.
Minor and major UI bundle releases change how every page looks, and a green build says nothing about appearance, so a person reviews them.
